address: Leixlip, Co. Kildare and formerly of Creagh
noticeText: Suddenly, at home. Beloved wife of the late Michael. Deeply regretted by her adored son Donal, sisters May and Carmel, brothers Tom and Liam, brothers-in-law, sisters-in-law, aunts, cousins, nephews, nieces, relatives, neighbours and friends.Rest in PeaceRemoval from Cunningham's Funeral Home, Lucan to the Church of Our Lady’s Nativity, Leixlip, tomorrow, Wednesday evening, arriving at 6pm. Funeral on Thursday, after 11am Mass, to Confey Cemetery.
